posts.text: Gemini 4 Argon is now available worldwide as Google's most capable frontier model. Google is making Gemini 4 Argon available worldwide through its API, the Gemini app, and Google Antigravity. The frontier model is aggressively priced but trails Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 and Meta's Muse Wonder Full in independent benchmarks. Internally, Google says Argon already cut coding tasks from months to weeks. posts.text: DeepL CEO on Voice AI Growth and Competition. DeepL CEO Jarek Kutylowski discusses surging demand for voice-to-voice translation and how AI is transforming global business. He also addresses competition with OpenAI and Anthropic, DeepL’s AWS strategy, European data sovereignty, recent workforce cuts and why the company is comfortable remaining private. He spoke with Bloomberg’s Tom Mackenzie, at the International AI Summit in Dublin, Ireland. (Source: Bloomberg)
